messages:
Emma: FYI CloudFrame (acct CF-332) opened a billing dispute for INV-4822 (Feb) claiming ~12.3k in unexpected embedding/rerank charges.
Rajesh: Can someone drop the meter dump? want to see model ids and peak timestamps.
Emma: Meter + invoice: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-4822  https://logs.redwood.example/cf-332/usage/2026-02
Jordan: CS spoke with them. They say a new data connector doubled traffic for 3 hours and some tests hit the rerank model by mistake. Customer offered $5k today, wants to split the rest over 30 days. No suspension request.
Sara: Suggest standard 30-day installment but structured: 30% upfront, 35% at day15, 35% at day30. Waive late fee only if all payments on time. Also require written acknowledgement withdrawing dispute for the amount covered by plan.
Henry: Legal: we need a signed addendum stating dispute withdrawal and waiver of chargeback for planed portion. I can prepare a one-paragraph addendum.
Rajesh: I can check logs now and confirm model IDs/token counts. If misbilling occurred (wrong model id), we should consider a partial credit.
Emma: Jordan, ask them to accept a temporary daily token cap while on the plan so they don't repeat the spike.
Jordan: They said they'd accept a reasonable cap. I'll schedule a call tomorrow morning to finalize and get payment.
collections-bot: Dunning bot: 2nd_notice sent to CF-332 for INV-4822 at 1981234012. Escalation: account hold in 7 days if unpaid.
Emma: Let's avoid hold. Plan: take $5k now, get signed addendum, set cap, finalize schedule on call. @Henry can you have addendum by EOD?
Henry: Yep will drop draft in #legal-review by 17:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Sara: Also flag this under pricing-experiments: if connectors commonly double traffic we may need a metering rule to detect sudden spikes and route to cheaper model or block test traffic.
Rajesh: Pulled the logs: rerank model id redwood/rerank-large-v2 used between 14:12-17:05 UTC on 2026-02-14; peak tokens 4.2M in that window. Will post a short summary after verifying counts.
Emma: Great. If we get $5k and a signed addendum, Collections will mark invoice "On Payment Plan" and postpone hold. Jordan update after call please.
Jordan: Will do. Call set for 10:00 PT tomorrow. Thanks all.
